interfaces.limit_inputs: GPIO33 open limit; GPIO18 close limit; normally-closed contact to signal ground is a provisional interface
constraints: All GPIO signals are logic-level only and must not directly power a fan, relay coil or actuator.
Driver input thresholds, galvanic isolation, power supply and connector are not selected.
The firmware must interlock opposite window commands and hold external drivers inactive during reset.
Without tachometer/driver feedback, fan reported state is only controller output state, not proven airflow.
